newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Soros cedes stake in Moroccan Diwan at $17.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Soros cedes stake in Moroccan Diwan at $17.6 mln.

text.p: Morocco opened on Monday subscriptions on the Casablanca bourse for the sale of the 6.07 percent stake of U.S. businessman George Soros in investment companty Diwan, a broker at ABN-AMRO Finance said.
"Quantum Emerging Growth partners fund, which is owned by U.S. George Soros, is ceding on the Casablanca stock exchange 500,000 shares at 330 dirhams ($35.4) per share," the broker said.
Total stake floated on the bourse on Monday is estimated at $17.6 million, the broker said.
Soros initially owned nearly 13 percent stake in Diwan whose majority stake is held by Morocco's largest private ONA Group .
The closing date for subscription was set for May 30, 1997, a bourse official said.
Morocco's leading banks Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, Banque Commerciale du Maroc and Casablanca Finance Group brokerage house were authorised to sell Diwan's shares.
One of the 47 listed stocks on the Casablanca bourse, Diwan shares are expected to rise up to 10 percent on the short term, Casablanca Finance Intermediation stockbroker said.
Diwan was traded last week at 374 dirhams, dealers said.
